Additional presentation checks

After-only captures; no matched baseline is claimed for these appearances or widths.

What changed, and why

Keep the original hierarchy

Was

The grouped counts and two-column layout were useful, but the right rail grew much longer than the primary column.

Now

The original strip and column proportions are retained. Recent activity occupies the unused left-column space below Up next, while gear, crew and upcoming events keep their right-hand locations.

Give quiet days less empty space

Was

Centered empty states used large icons and vertical padding that pushed later cards down.

Now

Short inline states keep their existing actions. Cards keep natural heights and all original information remains available.

Things to know

  • Local implementation on codex/dashboard-polish. Nothing is committed, pushed, merged or deployed.
  • Original source baseline is f1501f9c6f60ad54933f841926b41d9d78b66f53. Selected balanced-* captures bind to source.patch; prior exploration assets remain separate and are not selected in this review.
  • Fixtures demonstrate presentation and local interaction only. Authenticated authorization, durable booking changes and reminder delivery require separate managed-preview proof.
  • The original dirty checkout and Claude’s branch are preserved. Native clients, API contracts, permissions and card visibility are unchanged.
